states.name: Initial Setup

postconditions: Robot has moved forward from starting position

action.code: const terminals = document.querySelectorAll('[data-terminal]'); if(terminals.length > 0) { const tx = parseFloat(terminals[0].getAttribute('data-x')); const tz = parseFloat(terminals[0].getAttribute('data-z')); const dx = tx - window.__3D_STATE__.robotPositionX; const dz = tz - window.__3D_STATE__.robotPositionZ; const steps = 20; for(let i=0; i<steps; i++) { setTimeout(() => { if(Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dz)) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: dx > 0 ? 'd' : 'a'})); setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: dx > 0 ? 'd' : 'a'})), 50); } else { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: dz > 0 ? 's' : 'w'})); setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: dz > 0 ? 's' : 'w'})), 50); } }, i * 100); } setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'e'})), steps * 100 + 200); }

postconditions: Robot has moved near a terminal and initiated hacking
Camera may have detected robot during hacking, strike registered if detected

action.code: for(let t=0; t<2; t++) { setTimeout(() => { const terminals = document.querySelectorAll('[data-terminal]'); for(let i=0; i<terminals.length; i++) { if(terminals[i].getAttribute('data-hacked') !== 'true') { const tx = parseFloat(terminals[i].getAttribute('data-x')); const tz = parseFloat(terminals[i].getAttribute('data-z')); const dx = tx - window.__3D_STATE__.robotPositionX; const dz = tz - window.__3D_STATE__.robotPositionZ; const steps = 15; for(let j=0; j<steps; j++) { setTimeout(() => { if(Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dz)) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: dx > 0 ? 'd' : 'a'})); setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: dx > 0 ? 'd' : 'a'})), 40); } else { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: dz > 0 ? 's' : 'w'})); setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: dz > 0 ? 's' : 'w'})), 40); } }, j * 80); } setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'e'})), steps * 80 + 200); break; } } }, t * 2500); }

postconditions: At least two terminals have been hacked successfully

action.code: const exitGate = document.querySelector('[data-exit-gate]'); if(exitGate) { const ex = parseFloat(exitGate.getAttribute('data-x')) || 12; const ez = parseFloat(exitGate.getAttribute('data-z')) || 12; const dx = ex - window.__3D_STATE__.robotPositionX; const dz = ez - window.__3D_STATE__.robotPositionZ; const steps = 30; for(let i=0; i<steps; i++) { setTimeout(() => { if(Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dz)) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: dx > 0 ? 'd' : 'a'})); setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: dx > 0 ? 'd' : 'a'})), 50); } else { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: dz > 0 ? 's' : 'w'})); setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: dz > 0 ? 's' : 'w'})), 50); } }, i * 100); } }
